comment: Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: clicking a Country row opens "Edit Country" with its data filled in. Automated test TC-RGN-Country-11 / 21.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: clicking a Currency row opens "Edit Currency" again (Symbol can be changed). Automated test TC-APP-Currency-11 / 21.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: the Resource menu items are singular now - "Resource Type" and "Asset" (like "Personnel"). Automated tests TC-RES-ResourceType-01 / TC-RES-Asset-01.

Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: the Name field stops at 150 characters on all 24 screens that were wrong (Region, Product, Resource, Organization, Application, Accounts > Configuration). Automated tests TC-*-19.

Partly fixed on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: the empty-search message is now correct on Role, Theme, Personnel and Asset ("There are no records in <screen>"). STILL WRONG on Account (Accounts > Configuration): it says "There are no records in Chart Of Accounts". Automated test TC-ACC-Account-06 (first screenshot = Account, second = Role fixed).

Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: adding an existing name with spaces around it is rejected with "already exists" on Product Type, Product Class, Supplement, Allotment, Addon, Market and Resource Type. Automated tests TC-*-06.

Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: adding a Branch / Department now says "Branch created successfully" / "Department created successfully", like every other screen. Automated tests TC-BRANCH-01 / TC-DEPARTMENT-01.

Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: Province and City reject duplicate names - same name ("This province already exists."), other letter case, spaces around, and renaming to an existing name. Automated tests TC-PROVINCE-04/05/06/09, TC-CITY-04/05/06/09.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: a deactivated City is no longer offered in the Landmark "City" dropdown. Automated test TC-CITY-12.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: Asset rejects duplicate names (same name, other letter case, spaces around). Automated tests TC-ASSET-04/05/06.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: the same Personnel -> Asset pairing that is already listed can no longer be added again. Automated test TC-RMAP-05.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: /flex/11 no longer opens a working "Flex 11" list (only Flex 1-10). Automated test TC-FLEX-15.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: switching a retention rule on / off no longer saves silently (no save is sent without asking). Automated test TC-RET-04.
Verified FIXED on the stage build of 22 Nov 2026: the logged-in admin's own switch on Users is locked - the admin can no longer deactivate their own account. Automated test TC-USR-07.
